title: Keep the recovery factory physical when the implemented channel leaks outside ideal support
statement: After source calls, measure irrep lambda and replace invalid length(lambda)>r by a known discard/reset branch. On rank-r sources the bad CP branch has zero Choi trace and is identically zero on all inputs/references. Thus ONE fixed controller is CPTP for Ftilde as well as ideal F, paying the query hybrid without assigning Ftilde rank r. A flag replacer gives every NONZERO mean eigenvalue floor mu; the actual unitary/discard Petz circuit is globally CPTP and compared only after occupied F_xi outputs, never globally against its non-TP zero extension.
